### What are you really trying to do?


Connect open telemetry interceptors
https://github.com/temporalio/sdk-php-interceptors-opentelemetry


### Describe the bug

When using opentelemetry interceptors, we receive the following error:

OpenTelemetry: [warning] attribute with non-primitive or non-homogeneous array of primitives dropped: header in /app/vendor/open-telemetry/sdk/Common/Attribute/AttributesBuilder.php(72)

And as a result, opentelemetry will not be able to send a trace.
